Rducks: R user-defined functions for DuckDB

Source: R/package.R
Rducks-package.Rd

Rducks is an R package and DuckDB extension bridge for registering R functions as DuckDB user-defined functions.

Details

The design keeps the DuckDB extension as the canonical execution surface and uses R for ergonomic registration, R function lifetime management, and scalar or vectorized function execution over DuckDB chunks.
